summary: Bullish filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, containing a press release announcing it received approval from the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission to offer trading in tokenized securities. This is a regulatory milestone and business development, not a special situation transaction. The filing does not disclose any specific deal terms, prices, premiums, or board recommendations related to M&A, activist campaigns, or other special-situation categories. The approval allows Bullish to operate a regulated venue for tokenized securities trading, with go-live expected in weeks. As a routine regulatory update, this filing does not trigger a special-situation classification.
